Introduction. Draugr are aggressive creatures found in Swamps and in Draugr villages, Sunken Crypts and sometimes Mountain towers. They are ancient undead Vikings that have since become bloated in appearance.

Attacks and abilities. Draugr come in two variants: 75% of them are equipped with axes and the other 25% have bows.

Axe. Does a horizontal slash that extends 2.2 meters and arcs 90 degrees (48 Slash and 15 Tier 0 Chop damage). This attack has a 3-second cooldown and can be used within 1.6 meters of a player.

Bow. Nocks an arrow and shoots the player (48 Pierce damage). The arrow travels at 30 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 2–20 degrees. This attack has a 4-second cooldown and can be used within 20 meters of a player.

Notes. • Entering a Sunken Crypt and leaving Draugr alive there will count towards spawn caps effectively suppressing their spawns in a large area.
• Draugr or Draug - "the undead of Valheim", also called aptrganga or aptrgangr in the Norse literature. Draugr live in their graves, often guarding treasure buried with them in their burial mound.
